dialogues.speaker: "Yumemizuki's Cozy Corner"
dialogues.text: "Worries and sorrow, anxiety and fear... Negative emotions can lurk deep within our consciousness, seeping out to disturb our dreams time and time again..."

dialogues.speaker: "Yumemizuki's Cozy Corner"
dialogues.text: "Why not take a break from your delightful vacation to soothe any lingering worries and find some inner peace..."

dialogues.speaker: "Yumemizuki's Cozy Corner"
dialogues.text: "Yumemizuki's Cozy Corner is here to help. The special psychotherapy services offered by our dream-eating baku can help dispel the shadows in your soul."

dialogues.speaker: "Yumemizuki's Cozy Corner"
dialogues.text: "What's more, the Natlan branch of the Aisa Bathhouse is already under construction. We hope to welcome you soon!"
